lines.en: I walk slowly through the ferns.
The plates on my back sway.
All four legs plant firmly.
I take a bite, then walk on.
My tail swings behind me.
I pass a cycad.

lines.zh: 我的身子重，步子却很慢。
lines.en: I am heavy, but my pace is slow.
I walk along the clearing.

lines.zh: 背板在阳光下一块块亮。
lines.en: My plates brighten one by one in the sun.
I go around a muddy pool.

lines.zh: 我听见自己的脚步很闷。
lines.en: My footfalls sound dull.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转身，尾刺指着后面。
lines.en: I turn, spikes pointing behind.
My head is small and does not rise high.
Every stretch, I stop to chew.
I stand with my plates to the sun.
I chew the fern in my mouth.

lines.zh: 我几乎不动，只有尾巴晃。
lines.en: I barely move; only my tail sways.
Wind sounds through my plates.
There are enough ferns here for a while.
I lift my head and see nothing.
My tail hangs naturally.

lines.zh: 我在听林子里有没有大的东西。
lines.en: I listen for anything large in the wood.
I breathe slowly.
A small insect lands on a plate.

lines.zh: 我把重量挪到后面的腿。
lines.en: I shift my weight to the hind legs.
I am patient; eating grass needs no hurry.
The sun has moved; so have I.
I blink and go back to chewing.

lines.zh: 你站在我尾巴那边，不好。
lines.en: You are by my tail; not wise.

lines.zh: 我没有恶意，你别靠太近。
lines.en: I mean no harm; do not come too close.
My small head lifts to look at you.

lines.zh: 我的头很小，可我的尾巴很重。
lines.en: My head is small; my tail is heavy.
You've just come out of the ferns.
I do not eat you; I eat ferns.
Do not touch my plates.

lines.zh: 你退到侧边来，那里安全。
lines.en: Come round to my side; it is safer.

lines.zh: 我嚼着蕨，把你从头看到脚
lines.en: Still chewing fern, I look you over.
You crushed a fern.
I am not afraid; I am only slow.
Stand still and I will walk around.
You cut into my plate.

lines.zh: 板缝里进了东西，很钝地疼
lines.en: Something's in a plate seam, dull and sore.
I step back slowly.
That did not cut through.
I rumble and raise my tail.
I turn to guard my legs.
Blood runs from between the plates.
That landed square behind my neck.
I am not about to fall.
A pale score is left on my plate.
Ferns; I like ferns.
This doesn't smell like fern.
What you hold is too little.
Your arm must ache; set it down.
This mouthful of fern takes me a while.
This is not as good as cycad.
I still have half a mouthful.
Step back and I will come and eat.

lines.zh: 为这一口，我不值得抬腿
lines.en: Not worth lifting a leg for.
Good; I will take this mouthful.
You bounce off; I don't step back.
I did not move; you fell back.
That should have numbed half of you.
My plates are hard.
We collided and the soil shook.

lines.zh: 你贴在我的侧面，我看不见你。
lines.en: You are at my flank; I cannot see you.

lines.zh: 我把骨板对着你，慢慢挪
lines.en: Plates to you, I shift slowly.
That did not hurt you, did it.

lines.zh: 你从我的尾巴前面走过，危险。
lines.en: You walked in front of my tail; dangerous.
I step aside; go on.
I am busy with grass.
This body is big and slow.
There are no other stegosaurs here.
Right now I'm thinking only of ferns.
I go on chewing my fern.
That depends on the season.
I sway my tail slowly.
I have no such plan yet.
I lower my head and eat.
Move aside; I am going to those ferns.
I lower my head and curl it up.
It is so small in my mouth.
I slowly chew it.
This is hard to bite.

lines.zh: 这团东西滚到我的脚边
lines.en: This lump rolled up to my feet.
One nudge of my snout and it rolls off.
It fell in the mud.
Two chews and I spat it out.
It tastes odd; I will not eat it.
Leave it; later.
The ferns at the treeline stir.
I raise my head to look that way.
I have swung my tail around.
I turn my plates that way.

lines.zh: 那点个头，尾巴一下就够
lines.en: That small — one tail swing's enough.

lines.zh: 我不主动，除非它先动手。
lines.en: I do not start it unless it does.

lines.zh: 尾巴那边对着它，最稳妥
lines.en: Tail toward it — that's safest.
My tail spikes point at it.

lines.zh: 它的影子贴到我的脚边
lines.en: Its shadow reaches my feet.
I hold my ground.

lines.zh: 喉咙里的声音压得很低
lines.en: The sound in my throat drops low.
My tail spikes lift an inch.

lines.zh: 它要是再进一步，我就甩尾。
lines.en: One more step and I swing.
Good; the warning ends here.
I turn slowly to face it.
It circles to my flank.
My tail keeps tracking it.
It is cautious, testing me.
I step back half a pace to give room.
It does not dare approach the tail.
I wait for it to decide.
Its shadow is short on the ground.
I slowly tense my hind legs.
It stopped and went no further.

lines.zh: 它退到我的尾刺够不着处
lines.en: It stays just past my spikes.
We both wait for the other to move.
It turns and leaves.
I go back to my grass.
The area is quiet again.
The spikes whip in from the side.
The spikes hit it with a solid sound.
It is knocked back several steps.
I draw my tail back slowly.

lines.zh: 它从侧面撞我，我晃了一下。
lines.en: It rams my flank and I sway.

lines.zh: 前脚落下去，震得它一晃
lines.en: My forefoot lands and rocks it.
The ground is pressed into a hollow.
It dodges and only mud flies.
I swing my tail once more.
That one missed.
I turn to face it squarely.

lines.zh: 尾风扫过去，它滚了两圈
lines.en: The tail wind sends it rolling twice.
My breathing is heavier now.
It withdraws into the trees; I do not follow.
I rise out of the ferns.
My plates stand up one by one.
This wood has what I eat.
I settle onto all four legs.

lines.zh: 我第一个动作是低头吃草。
lines.en: My first act is to lower my head and eat.
The sun warms my plates.
The tremor comes up through my feet.
I must be careful with this tail.

lines.zh: 地上被我的脚压出一片印。
lines.en: My feet leave a patch of prints.
I eat slowly and am in no hurry.

lines.zh: 空气里有湿土和蕨的味道。
lines.en: The air smells of wet soil and fern.
Good; first a bite.

lines.zh: 我把头转向响动的方向。
lines.en: I turn my head to the sound.
My shadow is large and low.

lines.zh: 又有东西进这片林子了。
lines.en: Something else has entered this wood.
I take one slow step forward.
The grass flattens under me.
The clouds hang low at the horizon.
Fire burns between my plates.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚下去，摔得很重。
lines.en: I roll down the slope and land hard.

lines.zh: 水淹到我的背，我抬头猛喘。
lines.en: Water reaches my back and I gasp upward.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我的侧腹炸开一片。
lines.en: The blast opens my flank.
An arrow lodges between my plates.

lines.zh: 那股力量钻进我的骨板。
lines.en: That force works between my plates.
The ferns are gone and I am hungry.

lines.zh: 雷打在骨板上，整片都亮了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes my plates and they all light up.
I fall, four legs kicking at nothing.
